issue: NumPy 2.4.6 installed but requirements pin numpy==1.26.4; torch 2.2.0 was compiled against NumPy 1.x, so importing torch fails (UserWarning: Failed to initialize NumPy) and torch.cuda.is_available() returns False. GenerativeEngine therefore reports 'GPU available: False' and stays disabled.

evidence.runtime: Import OK; GPU available: False; Engine instance: False

proposed_fix: downgrade numpy to 1.26.4: ../venv/bin/pip install 'numpy==1.26.4' --force-reinstall, then re-run check
lower_gpu_threshold: MIN_GEN_VRAM_GB default is 10; if GPU has less VRAM, set to 6 to enable
